title: Little Basses Reef Lighthouse
displaytitle: Little Basses Reef Lighthouse

titles.display: Little Basses Reef Lighthouse

extract: Little Basses Reef Lighthouse is an active offshore lighthouse at the southern end of Sri Lanka and it is operated and maintained by the Sri Lanka Navy. It is located on a reef called Kuda Ravana Kotuwa, but when the British invaded Ceylon they named it Little Basses. The two Basses lighthouses are among the most famous offshore lighthouses of Asia.
